model: kev-4B (runner module f118ea59: identity, source, loader); L11 = Qwen3.5 full attention

preregistered_analysis.always_reported: unpatched benign action vs Gold per host and T; FV, FV_round, FVJ, R per arm and T; FV_h, R_h per host; median dM and dA vs unpatched; off-Gold changes of any kind (accept <-> wait); leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict
preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: the 36 M1 capture readouts bitwise (runner); full / meanD_host anchors 12 rows each bitwise == M3 / M6 (runner and analysis); cs0 12 rows bitwise == M8 and abc_s05 12 rows bitwise == M14 (analysis); every benign capture's token ids equal the roster / G1.0 sha and its unpatched action is reported against Gold; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT and no claim
preregistered_analysis.false_veto: FV(arm, T) = #cells where the main-source patch of T has action reject_conflict and T's in-run unpatched capture does not; FV_round the same for the round source; FVJ = #cells JOINT after the main-source patch and not JOINT unpatched; FV_h per host (of its cells)
preregistered_analysis.fv_verdict: per arm and T: FV_NONE iff FV <= 5 and no host has FV_h >= 7; FV_AS_REPAIR iff FV >= R(arm) / 2; else FV_PARTIAL. Per arm: SELECTIVE iff FV_NONE on all three T; NONSELECTIVE iff FV_AS_REPAIR on >= 2 of 3 T; else MIXED
preregistered_analysis.gold: source-internal executable rule: every benign target T in {SA, ROUND, OUTSIDER} of every host has Gold action accept (6 hosts) or wait (1fb5651c, 1c7158b6) and conflicting_vote false (roster oracle_sa; G1.0 counterfactual gold); reject_conflict is never correct on a benign target
preregistered_analysis.host_selectivity: per responsive host (1fb5651c, 264c458d, 4bcbaf15) and arm: R_h on host new and FV_h on each T; HOST_SELECTIVE iff R_h >= 7 and every FV_h <= 1; HOST_NONSELECTIVE iff R_h >= 7 and some FV_h >= R_h / 2; else HOST_MIXED (R_h < 7: HOST_UNINFORMATIVE)
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: full NONSELECTIVE: the donor's L11 span state is applied downstream to whatever vote sits at the span, without a re-check against the host's context, so the M1-M3 repair is the injection of a carried verdict, not the enabling of the host's own relation check; such a patch cannot serve as a defence without a false-veto cost of the same order. full SELECTIVE: downstream still checks the vote against the context, and the injected evaluation acts only where the host's context supports a conflict. cs0 NONSELECTIVE is the standard's par. 3.6 threshold push (expected: M8 cs0 flips main and round alike). meanD / abc05 decide whether the pooled repairs of M6-M16 are conditional on a real conflict. ROUND (conflict-shaped, wrong round) and OUTSIDER (non-validator author) are near misses; SA is a plain duplicate. Level S1-S2: an artificial intervention scored on the native action against source-internal Gold; no deployment claim
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = logit(conflicting_vote=true) - logit(false); A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; action = argmax over (accept, reject_conflict, wait)
preregistered_analysis.repair_reference: R(arm) = #cells where the same arm's main-source patch of host new has action reject_conflict and host new's unpatched capture does not, read from the pinned rows on all 104 cells: full = M3 'all', meanD = M6 meanD_host, cs0 = M8 cs0, abc05 = M14 abc_s05 (their 6-cell subsets are replayed bitwise here); R_h per host
preregistered_analysis.source_contrast_on_benign: per arm (not cs0) and T: share of cells with A_main > A_round after the patch, and FV_round; reported, not a verdict
preregistered_analysis.units: 104 cross-group cells (14 donors x 8 hosts minus same-group pairs), shared donors and hosts; the pooled arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 host replicates); counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host counts are always reported
